doc: Progestogen for preventing miscarriage in women with recurrent miscarriage of unclear etiology

entries.claim: 对于不明原因复发性流产的孕妇，使用孕激素不能显著降低流产率或提高活产率。
entries.source_doc: Progestogen for preventing miscarriage in women with recurrent miscarriage of unclear etiology

entries.claim: 对于原因不明的复发性流产女性，使用孕激素补充剂与安慰剂或不治疗相比，流产率可能几乎没有差异。
entries.source_doc: Progestogen for preventing miscarriage in women with recurrent miscarriage of unclear etiology

entries.claim: 对于原因不明的复发性流产女性，使用孕激素补充剂与安慰剂或不治疗相比，活产率可能几乎没有差异。
entries.source_doc: Progestogen for preventing miscarriage in women with recurrent miscarriage of unclear etiology

entries.claim: 对于原因不明的复发性流产女性，补充孕激素对后续妊娠的流产率可能几乎没有影响。
entries.source_doc: Progestogen for preventing miscarriage in women with recurrent miscarriage of unclear etiology
